description: 白方弃后换车，双车连续将军完成底线杀
explanation_en: White sacrifices the queen to exchange off one rook, then uses a series of rook checks to deliver back-rank mate.

intro.popup: 💡 底线杀：黑王在g8，黑双车守底线（a8、b8）。白后在f4、双车在d4和d1。如何打开底线？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Back-rank mate: Black's king is on g8, guarded by rooks on a8 and b8. White has a queen on f4 and rooks on d4 and d1. How can White open the back rank?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Qxb8+弃后迫Rxb8，再Rd8+迫Rxd8，Rxd8#——连续弃子换车，将车诱入封死的底线格。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Qxb8+ sacrifices the queen to force ...Rxb8. Rd8+ then forces ...Rxd8, and Rxd8# finishes the mate. The sacrifices draw the rooks onto the blocked back rank.

moves.popup: 白后Qxb8+！弃后吃车将军，黑方必须用a8车应将。
moves.popup_en: Qxb8+! White sacrifices the queen to capture a rook with check. Black must recapture with the rook from a8.

moves.popup: 黑车a8吃后——b8现在只剩一个黑车。
moves.popup_en: The rook from a8 captures the queen; Black now has only one rook left on b8.

moves.popup: 白车Rd8+！将军，黑车必须到d8挡。底线仅剩一个格子。
moves.popup_en: Rd8+! White checks, forcing Black's rook to block on d8. Only one back-rank square remains open.

moves.popup: 黑车b8到d8挡将——底线现在只有黑车，被白车钉死。
moves.popup_en: The rook moves from b8 to d8 to block. It is now the only piece on the back rank and is pinned by White's rook.

moves.popup: Rxd8#！白车吃掉最后一个守卫，将死黑王。
moves.popup_en: Rxd8#! White's rook captures the last defender and checkmates the black king.
